metadata.description: Generic, tested, high-quality mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Stops risky git commands Claude runs through Bash (force pushes, pushes to main, reset --hard, clean -f, branch -D, discarding changes, dropping stashes, rebasing main), denying them or routing them to your permission prompt, each rule toggleable

plugins.name: sensitive-paths
plugins.description: Blocks Claude from reading or writing secret-bearing files (.env, SSH keys, cloud credentials, and your own globs) through the file tools and, best effort, Bash

plugins.name: pr-desc-verifier
plugins.description: Before Claude runs gh pr create or gh pr edit, shows you the PR's title and description and waits for your approval; reject it with feedback and Claude revises

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: A /worktrees pane listing the current repo's git worktrees with branch, dirty files, ahead/behind, last commit, and lock/prunable markers; copy a path or insert a cd from any row

plugins.name: modal-containers
plugins.description: A /modal pane listing your running Modal containers by app, with who launched each run and what it has cost, plus your workspace's month-to-date spend and top apps, and a spend badge under the prompt that turns red past your budget (macOS/Linux)

plugins.name: docker-containers
plugins.description: A /docker pane listing your local Docker containers grouped by compose project, with image, published ports, CPU, memory and status; pick the Docker context and whether to include stopped containers in the plugin's settings

plugins.name: my-issues
plugins.description: A /issues pane of the open issues assigned to you across GitHub, Linear, Jira and monday.com; press an issue to put its key, title and link in your prompt

plugins.name: vercel-deploys
plugins.description: A /vercel-deploys pane of your recent Vercel deployments: state, environment, branch, commit, creator, age and URL, with the current git branch highlighted

plugins.name: render-deploys
plugins.description: A /render-deploys pane of your recent Render deploys: state, service, environment, branch, commit, trigger, age and link, with the current git branch highlighted

plugins.name: skill-trace
plugins.description: A /skill-trace pane showing which skills loaded in this session, when, from which plugin, whether the model or you invoked them, and how large their instructions were

plugins.name: sources
plugins.description: A /sources pane listing every web page Claude fetched or saw in search results this session, deduplicated by URL, with a button that inserts them as citations into your prompt
